The new `_from_xarray` unconditionally calls `_unflatten_snapshots` for snapshot-indexed arrays attached to a network, without checking semantics or the new option. For an array with a flat, tuple-valued snapshot index and matching auxiliary coordinates, this converts that index to a MultiIndex before the existing pandas conversion, whereas base_commit leaves it flat; thus such inputs can produce different results even under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`.
